description: Files a feature request on heistclips' public board (heistclips.com/requests) and emails the person who builds it. For something heistclips or this connector does not do yet: a platform, a layout, captions, alerts, a campaign source. `title` is the user's own words, verbatim and short, `detail` is optional, and `contact` is an email or handle exactly as they offered it. ok true means it was filed.

contact.description: Optional: email or handle for a reply, verbatim, only if offered

detail.description: Optional: what they were trying to do

not_a_stream.description: Only if a previous call said the title looks like a stream and the user confirms it is really a feature request

title.description: What they want, in their own words, under 90 characters

name: request_a_feature
title: Request a heistclips feature
